items.detail: Ensure the document has at most one contentinfo landmark

items.detail: Ensure links have discernible text

items.detail: Ensure select element has an accessible name

items.detail: Ensure that server-side image maps are not used

items.detail: Ensure touch targets have sufficient size and space
